_note: NPC (docs/ART-REDO.md section 4). The concept sheets have no vagrant, so the box is the theme.jpg timber house for its brown and cream, and the source_note says so. type is monster because a figure that is not a seated hero is asset.json on that path. World height 32 is a person, the hero's height, 88 px; the cell is 128. Clips are idle on S W N E and walk on eight directions. v-S is a slight three-quarter turn, recorded for the final review: views only scales the figure, so that facing is not a retake. The third walk-W holds the profile. Every walk frame is 84 to 89 px, every start pose is 88, and the feet sit on outline row 121. The check profile uses the sheet's own colours. The front floor is 0.64 times the S start pose's cream count (304 to 194). The back ceiling is half that floor (97), and the top 30% of N has no cream (measured 0, ceiling 2). The snapshot lists vagrants and the client draws this sheet.
